about.subtitleProjectCard:
Artillery Command is a tactical simulation game focused on coordination, precision, and strategic resource management. Players must calculate trajectories using grid coordinates and manage radio communications to successfully destroy enemy targets.

The project aims to synchronize mathematical logic with an interactive digital environment, creating a challenging and immersive experience.
